title: First Information Report (FIR-2026-8801)
content_text: Complainant alleges unauthorized wire transfer of Rs 45,00,000 from corporate escrow account via spoofed banking IP addresses.

title: Witness Statement of Bank Nodal Officer
content_text: Witness Suresh Patel confirms login attempt from IP 192.168.1.45 using compromise admin credentials.

title: Seizure Memo of Server Hard Drive
content_text: Physical seizure of RAID 5 storage array from server room at Sector 62 Noida. Hardware serial: WD-9921-X.

title: Crime Scene Physical Media Photograph
content_text: High-resolution photographic capture of seized server rack, unbroken anti-tamper security seals, and port connections.

title: CFSL Cyber Forensic Analysis Report
content_text: Disk image analysis revealed malware payload 'Ratchet-V2' injected at 03:14 AM. MAC address traced to suspect Arun Kumar.

title: Interim Investigation Findings Report
content_text: Correlating forensic report DOC-005 and witness statement DOC-002 confirms primary suspect involvement of Arun Kumar.

title: Supplementary Financial Trail Report
content_text: Bank transaction logs reveal immediate layering into cryptocurrency wallets across 3 offshore exchanges.

title: Final Charge Sheet under IPC 420 & IT Act 66D
content_text: Comprehensive formal charge sheet establishing accused Arun Kumar's guilt under IT Act Section 66D and IPC Section 420.

title: District Court Evidentiary Filing
content_text: Official filing to Judicial Magistrate requesting remand and asset freezing orders based on charge sheet DOC-008.

title: Charge Sheet Hindi Regional Translation
content_text: Official certified Hindi translation of Charge Sheet DOC-008 for court record and accused copy service.

title: Redacted Witness Statement for Public Record
content_text: Redacted derivative of DOC-002 scrubbing PII numbers, home address, and phone details pursuant to Section 44.

title: Revised Final Investigation Report
content_text: Updated investigation report incorporating supplementary offshore banking responses and CFSL updates.

title: FIR for Cyber Ransomware Attack
content_text: Ransomware encryption incident reported by National Health Portal server admin.

title: Ransomware Binary Decompilation Report
content_text: Malware reverse engineering confirms LockBit 3.0 variant with hardcoded C2 server IP.

title: Cyber Terrorism Charge Sheet IT Act 66F
content_text: Charges filed under IT Act Section 66F (Cyber Terrorism) against international syndicate nodes.

title: FIR for Bank Document Forgery
content_text: Forged bank guarantee certificates submitted for government tender allocation.

title: Forged Bank Guarantee Hardcopy
content_text: Seized physical bank guarantee paper bearing fake stamp and signature of Manager.

title: Handwriting & Ink Chemistry Analysis Report
content_text: CFSL document examiner confirms ink signature mismatch and fake rubber stamp impression.
